workflow_name: NutriGuide - PS8 Nutrition Agent RAG Workflow
compatibility_note: LangFlow native import/export JSON varies by release. This version-neutral manifest records the actual intended components and edges; build or map these nodes in your installed LangFlow version. It has not been validated as a native flow import.

components.purpose: Collect the user's text query and session context.
Route a task to the Nutrition Knowledge, Diet Recommendation, Health Advisory, or Food Log and Feedback function.
Make retrievable food/guidance documents while preserving one food record as a useful chunk.
Use IBM Slate in configured IBM mode or a local TF-IDF equivalent for offline demo.
Index document embeddings and metadata for similarity search.
Retrieve top relevant food and guidance records and their source metadata.
Combine query, retrieved context, validated deterministic draft and safety instructions.
Optional generation with ibm/granite-3-3-8b-instruct after account access is confirmed.
Display answer, source references, and explicit live/demo status.

safety_rules: Filter every meal component for declared diet and allergens before model generation.
Use deterministic CSV calculations; model cannot change calculated values or add foods.
Return an explicit not-found response when relevant retrieved context is absent.
Never diagnose, prescribe, or claim professional medical suitability.
Label offline output as DEMO; do not imply IBM Granite was called.
runtime_note: The Streamlit app executes its equivalent Python pipeline directly. It does not depend on or call a running LangFlow instance.
